name: Midnight Milk
body:
Price 50 gp; Weight —

DETAILS

Type drug (ingested); Addiction moderate, Fort DC 16

EFFECTS

1 hour; fatigue, plus the user takes a –4 penalty on all saving throws made to resist sleep effects. If the user falls asleep while under the effects of midnight milk, he dreams vividly; these dreams last for 1 hour per dose of midnight milk taken in the past month (including this one). Upon awakening, the user is revitalized as if he had enjoyed a full 8 hours of sleep.

DAMAGE

1d2 Wis damage.

Experimental Midnight Milk: Poison—ingested; save Fort DC 14; frequency 1/minute for 2 minutes; initial effect  fatigued 1 hour; secondary effect unconsciousness for 2d4 hours plus nightmare (as the character sleeps he has dreams of being drawn enslaved by shadowy overlords. To the dreaming PC the effect seems to last for years, and the character is exhausted upon waking); cure 1 save.
